sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their excellent recent form. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five matches (four wins and a draw) and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, while Alsager Town arrive in poor form, having won just once in their last six outings and occupying bottom place with only 4 points.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough test away at Dawley Town in a fixture that could have title-race implications, with Stafford just two points behind the leaders. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth welcome Eccleshall in a match between two mid-table contenders, though AFC Bridgnorth have shown stronger recent form with a win in their most recent outing. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a local rivalry clash between teams currently separated by six points in the table. Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir seeking to maintain their solid run of form. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town, both teams struggling to find consistency in the lower half of the table. Barnton host Shawbury United, with the visitors in dire form having lost five of their last six matches. Crewe face Allscott Heath in a basement-battle clash between two struggling sides, while Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town and Widnes Town host Brereton Social complete the weekend's fixtures.
